observed_evidence.latest_security_failure: Refusing unreviewed workflow secret consumption in .github/workflows/live-host-tenant-isolation-proof.yml
observed_evidence.tenant_isolation_run_failure: WFM_DEMO_PASSWORD repository secret is not configured.
observed_evidence.reason_no_exposure_observed: The failing tenant-isolation run exited at the empty-secret guard before browser launch/authentication.
observed_evidence.hosted_runtime_status: Railway customer-proof latest deployment remained SUCCESS and /api/health returned 200 during the correlated CI failure window.
observed_evidence.observed_runner_browser: HeadlessChrome/152.0.0.0 on public hosted proof traffic

causal_timeline.event: A new live-host tenant-isolation workflow was added directly to main with a step-scoped WFM_DEMO_PASSWORD reference.

The tenant-isolation workflow and repository every-push security gate both failed. The repository gate rejected the new secret-bearing workflow because the allowlist still named only the Railway deploy and live-browser proof workflows.
After two follow-up fixes to the tenant proof, the proof still failed; logs show WFM_DEMO_PASSWORD was not configured, so authentication did not start. The every-push security gate remained red.
Latest main again failed the every-push security gate for the same unreviewed secret workflow while Identity Runtime Guard remained green.

inferred_root_cause: Credential-bearing workflow policy was encoded as a hard-coded two-file shell allowlist rather than a declarative reviewed registry, so adding a third legitimate proof path created policy drift.
Main is not protected by required pre-update checks, so a workflow that violated the repository security contract could land before the gate reported the violation.
The new browser credential path did not inherit the pending shared Chrome security-floor control, creating a second stale-browser credential path if the repository secret is later configured.
systemic_prevention_prepared: Replace the shell file allowlist with a machine-readable credential-workflow policy and structural validator.
Require every secret-bearing workflow to be explicitly registered, owner-only, read-only, fixed-runner, exactly-one-secret and step-env scoped.
Require the shared browser security-floor preflight to execute before every browser credential step.
Add deterministic negative fixtures for an unregistered secret workflow, duplicate secret consumption and a browser credential workflow missing its floor preflight.
Keep tenant-isolation authentication blocked until both the browser floor passes and WFM_DEMO_PASSWORD is explicitly configured by an authorized owner.
recovery_rule: Do not bypass the central gate, do not inject a public/derivable password, and do not run credential-bearing browser proof on Chrome below the published Linux floor. Reconcile the policy and browser preflight first, then configure the repository secret through the authorized secret-management path, then rerun the proof.

metrics.reproducibility: high: the central gate deterministically rejects the unregistered workflow on current main

metrics.detection_effort_after_target: single machine-readable WFM_WORKFLOW_SECURITY code identifying the exact policy invariant
metrics.recovery_path_quality_before: ambiguous: proof failure and security-gate failure appeared as separate red signals
metrics.recovery_path_quality_after_target: ordered: policy registration -> browser floor -> secret configuration -> hosted proof
metrics.prevention_coverage_before: two explicitly named secret workflows; browser floor pending outside main
metrics.prevention_coverage_after_target: all secret-bearing workflows discovered repository-wide and reconciled against one reviewed registry; all browser credential paths require pre-secret floor

open_uncertainty: The repository remains unprotected on main; separate governance remediation remains required.
The GitHub repository secret WFM_DEMO_PASSWORD is currently absent for the tenant proof and must not be synthesized or made derivable.
The current hosted runner evidence shows Chrome 152, below the 153.0.8010.47 Linux floor; authenticated browser proof must remain fail-closed until an approved runner/browser satisfies the floor.
This mitigation is isolated on an autonomy branch and is not a production or main-branch change until reviewed/promoted.
